title: Best sales intelligence for rep prioritization (2027)
summary: Which sales intelligence tools tell reps who to work today and why? We compare 7 on scoring transparency, signal freshness and where reps see it.
body_markdown:
The best sales intelligence software for rep prioritization tells each rep exactly who to work today and why, using fresh signals, a score they can understand, and a list that shows up where they already work. UserGems is the strongest fit for teams that want custom, transparent scoring at both the account and contact level, delivered in the CRM, Slack, Chrome and AI assistants. ZoomInfo and Apollo are solid for database-first prospecting, LinkedIn Sales Navigator for relationship-led selling, 6sense for account-level intent, and Clay and Common Room for teams that build their own logic or lean on first-party signals.


### Why is rep prioritization still broken?


Most sales teams have plenty of data. What they lack is a clear answer to a simple question each morning: who should I call first?


Three things usually get in the way:


- **Scores reps don't trust.** A number from 0 to 100 with no explanation gets ignored. Reps fall back on gut feel. Here's[how to build a scoring model sales trusts](https://www.usergems.com/6sense-limitations/transparent-scoring-how-to-build-a-model-sales-trusts-and-can-explain) .
- **Stale signals.** A website visit from three weeks ago or intent that refreshes weekly means the moment has often passed.
- **Another dashboard.** If the priority list lives in a separate tool, reps don't open it. Priorities need to appear in Salesforce, HubSpot, the SEP, Slack or the AI assistant they already use.


We dig into this in[why dashboards don't get used, and what an AI command center does instead](https://www.usergems.com/6sense-limitations/what-is-an-ai-command-center-for-outbound-abm-and-why-dashboards-dont-get-used) .


### What should sales intelligence software do for prioritization?


1. **Score accounts and contacts.** Knowing the company is hot is half the answer. Reps need the person. See[contact-level vs account-level intent](https://www.usergems.com/6sense-limitations/contact-level-intent-vs-account-level-intent-the-complete-guide) .
2. **Explain the score.** Show the signals behind it: a new VP, a pricing page visit, intent on your category, a surge in engagement from the buying group.
3. **Use your history.** A model built on your own wins and losses beats industry averages. Learn[how to build a scoring model from your CRM](https://www.usergems.com/aeo-content-hub/how-to-build-an-abm-scoring-model-from-your-crm-not-generic-intent) .
4. **Stay fresh.** Signals and scores should refresh continuously.
5. **Show up where reps work.** CRM, SEP, browser, Slack, Claude or ChatGPT.


For a full framework, see[sales signal prioritization: the complete guide](https://www.usergems.com/blog/sales-signal-prioritization-the-complete-guide) .


### Best sales intelligence software for rep prioritization at a glance


**1. UserGems**


- **Best for:** Teams that want one trusted daily priority list for reps and marketing
- **Signal level:** Contact and account
- **Key strength:** Custom, transparent Scoring & Buying Stages built on your own wins and losses; delivered in the AI Chrome Extension, Slack and Claude or ChatGPT via MCP
- **Watch out for:** Built for B2B teams running outbound and ABM at scale, so it's more than a small team needs; it pushes priorities into your SEP and CRM rather than sending emails itself
- **Pricing:** Published plans from $40K/year with unlimited users


**2. ZoomInfo**


- **Best for:** Database-first prospecting with intent
- **Signal level:** Account intent plus contact data
- **Key strength:** Copilot ranks accounts and drafts outreach
- **Watch out for:** Test data accuracy in your segments
- **Pricing:** Custom quote; free trial; Copilot is an add-on


**3. Apollo**


- **Best for:** SMB and mid-market teams that want data, scoring and sequences together
- **Signal level:** Contact data; account-level intent
- **Key strength:** Auto and custom scoring models with visible criteria
- **Watch out for:** Scores show mainly in Apollo's own search, filters and profiles
- **Pricing:** Free plan; paid plans from $49/user/month; AI scoring on paid plans


**4. 6sense**


- **Best for:** Enterprise teams prioritizing by account intent
- **Signal level:** Mainly account
- **Key strength:** Predictive buying stages and large intent footprint
- **Watch out for:** Reps often can't see why an account scored high
- **Pricing:** Custom quote; no free plan or trial listed on G2


**5. LinkedIn Sales Navigator**


- **Best for:** Relationship-led selling on LinkedIn
- **Signal level:** Contact and account (LinkedIn activity)
- **Key strength:** Buyer intent, alerts and Account IQ from LinkedIn data
- **Watch out for:** Signals mostly limited to LinkedIn's ecosystem
- **Pricing:** Core $119.99/mo, Advanced $159.99/mo per seat (less billed annually); Advanced Plus custom


**6. Clay**


- **Best for:** GTM engineers building custom scoring
- **Signal level:** Depends on your build
- **Key strength:** 200+ data providers and AI research agents
- **Watch out for:** You build and maintain the scoring model
- **Pricing:** Free plan; paid plans listed from $167/mo; Enterprise custom


**7. Common Room**


- **Best for:** PLG and community-led teams
- **Signal level:** Contact and account
- **Key strength:** Resolves product and community activity to real people
- **Watch out for:** Value depends on volume of first-party signals
- **Pricing:** Essential $2,500/mo billed annually; Advanced and Enterprise custom; no free plan


### The 7 best sales intelligence tools for rep prioritization


#### [1. UserGems](https://www.usergems.com/)


UserGems is the AI command center for outbound and ABM. It keeps every account and contact that matters to you up to date automatically, with their signals, relationship with you, score and buying stage.


[Scoring & Buying Stages](https://www.usergems.com/product/scoring) answers two questions for every rep. Scoring asks "should we care about this account or contact?" using fit, funding, hiring, tech stack, intent, new hires, CRM activity and call transcripts, weighted by a custom model trained on your own wins and losses. Buying Stages asks "where are they in their journey with us?" and places each account in Unengaged, Awareness, Interest, Consideration or Decision.


Every score is transparent. Reps see the signals that drove it, and RevOps can adjust the weighting. Scores refresh continuously, so the list is today's. Reps see priorities in the AI Chrome Extension inside Salesforce, HubSpot, their SEP and LinkedIn, in Slack, and in Claude or ChatGPT through the UserGems MCP. The Gem-E Writing Agent drafts the first email from the same signals, and Workflows route hot contacts into the right sequence. Here's[how UserGems account scoring works](https://www.usergems.com/blog/how-usergems-account-scoring-works) .


**Best for:** teams that want sales and marketing working from one priority list reps trust. **Watch out for:** UserGems pushes priorities and drafts into your SEP and CRM, so those tools still do the sending and record keeping.


#### [2. ZoomInfo](https://www.zoominfo.com/)


ZoomInfo Copilot ranks accounts using buyer intent, company updates and org changes, flags re-engaged or quiet prospects, and drafts outreach, with connections to Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, Salesloft and Gong ([ZoomInfo](https://www.zoominfo.com/copilot-gtm) ). Copilot is sold as an add-on to ZoomInfo's core data.


**Best for:** teams that want a large contact database and prioritization in one contract. **Watch out for:** run a head-to-head data test in your segments first. UserGems has never lost a head-to-head data comparison.


#### [3. Apollo](https://apollo.io/)


Apollo Scores builds auto-score models from your CRM and Apollo history, or lets you set your own criteria and weights. Each lead shows the criteria behind its score, and reps can filter search by score ([Apollo](https://www.apollo.io/product/scores) ). Apollo's buying intent comes from third-party providers at the account level.


**Best for:** teams that want data, scoring and sequencing in one tool. **Watch out for:** priorities live mainly inside Apollo, and intent is account-level.


#### [4. 6sense](https://6sense.com/)


6sense places accounts in predictive buying stages using keyword intent, anonymous web visits resolved to accounts and third-party intent.


**Best for:** enterprise teams prioritizing at the account level. **Watch out for:** reps frequently ask why an account is "in Decision" and can't get an answer, and the platform names the company more often than the person. More in our breakdown of[6sense limitations](https://www.usergems.com/blog/limitations-of-6sense-2026) .


#### [5. LinkedIn Sales Navigator](https://www.linkedin.com/products/linkedin-sales-navigator/)


Sales Navigator gives reps lead and account alerts, buyer intent based on LinkedIn activity and Insight Tag website visits, and AI account summaries (Account IQ). Buyer Intent comes with Advanced and Advanced Plus ([LinkedIn](https://business.linkedin.com/sell/sales-navigator) ). Relationship features show connections and recent activity at target accounts.


**Best for:** reps who sell through LinkedIn relationships. **Watch out for:** its signals come mostly from LinkedIn's own network, so off-platform intent, product usage and CRM history need another source.


#### [6. Clay](https://www.clay.com/)


Clay lets GTM engineers pull from 200+ data providers and use AI agents to research and score accounts against custom criteria. Many teams[use Clay and UserGems together](https://www.usergems.com/blog/how-smart-teams-use-clay-and-usergems-together) .


**Best for:** teams with technical resources who want full control. **Watch out for:** the model, refresh schedule and rep-facing delivery are yours to build and maintain.


#### [7. Common Room](https://www.commonroom.io/)


Common Room unifies CRM, product, marketing and community signals and resolves them to real people, with AI that surfaces in Salesforce, Slack and browser extensions.


**Best for:** product-led companies with strong community or product signals. **Watch out for:** prioritization is only as strong as your first-party activity volume.


### How do you get reps to actually use prioritization?


- **Make the "why" one click away.** Every hot account should show the two or three signals that made it hot.
- **Put it in their flow.** A Slack message at 8am or a Chrome panel inside Salesforce beats a dashboard link. Here's what it looks like to go[from hot account to email sent](https://www.usergems.com/6sense-limitations/from-hot-account-to-email-sent-automating-execution-with-ai-agents) .
- **Pair priority with a first draft.** When a rep sees who to contact and a signal-based draft, they act faster.
- **Close the loop.** Measure which signals and stages turn into meetings and pipeline, then adjust the model.


### Frequently asked questions


#### What is sales intelligence software?


Sales intelligence software gives reps data and signals about accounts and contacts, such as firmographics, contact details, intent and website visits, to decide who to target and what to say. The most useful tools also score and prioritize those accounts automatically.


#### How is account scoring different from lead scoring?


Lead scoring usually ranks individual inbound leads on form fills and engagement. Account and contact scoring ranks every company and person in your market on fit and live buying signals, including people who haven't engaged yet.


#### Why don't sales reps trust account scores?


Usually because they can't see why an account scored high, or the score is based on industry averages instead of their own deals. Transparent scoring that shows the signals behind every score, built on your own win history, earns trust.


#### How often should prioritization scores refresh?


Continuously, or at least daily. Buying signals like new hires, website visits and intent spikes lose value fast, so weekly or monthly refreshes miss the window.


#### Can reps see UserGems priorities without logging in?


Yes. Reps see priorities in the AI Chrome Extension inside Salesforce, HubSpot, their SEP and LinkedIn, in Slack, and in Claude or ChatGPT through the UserGems MCP.
